lines.text: Time series intelligence meets real-time context. Foundation models transformed how enterprises unlock value from unstructured data, with language models, chatbots and agents. The bigger prize is time series and streaming data, where the mission-critical decisions live, from production and demand planning to anomaly detection. IBM Granite Time Series models now run live inside Confluent, pretrained to scale across plants, stores, products and customers, efficient on standard servers, and learning as each event lands.

lines.text: Take one store on a hot day. The forecast reads the heat wave and sees the stockout coming, so the empty shelf is flagged in seconds,

lines.text: and the next order is optimized to keep it full, while the decision still matters.

lines.text: That works because the intelligence lives where the data already flows. When store sales stall, the event lands in a governed Confluent topic, joins the live weather stream, and Granite forecasts it inside Flink. The shelf check goes out in under a second, while the usual way copies, trains and scores in a nightly batch, and is still a day behind.
